ignoreCommand: echo "ignore-step: VERCEL_ENV=$VERCEL_ENV ref=$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF sha=$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA"; if [ "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" = "main" ]; then echo 'main — building'; exit 1; fi; if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "preview" ]; then echo 'preview of a non-main branch — skipping'; exit 0; fi; echo 'unrecognised context — building'; exit 1
